description: Analysis runs, newest first: one analysis's or the project's, with id, number, name, status, where, when and error. With run_id (an id, or "<analysis>/<run name or number>"), that run: its inputs, its outputs and its dashboards' cards (id and title, for show_address). A failed run gives its error; runs({run_id, logs: true}) has its log.
name: analysis_runs
